CampaignRule.description: A condition set made binding on a campaign ("Use as campaign rule").
CampaignRule.title: CampaignRule

ConditionSet.description: Root of a filter: facets combine with AND (the default), free text alongside.
ConditionSet.title: ConditionSet

KitHistoryItem.description: Application history (personal backup only): blocks duplicates from day one.
KitHistoryItem.title: KitHistoryItem

radius.description: Base radius in px; small/large derive from it
radius.title: Radius

cv_template.description: CV template key for this track; null uses the documents setting
cv_template.title: Cv Template

letter_template.description: Letter template key; null uses the documents setting
letter_template.title: Letter Template

path.description: Path inside the zip, under vault/
path.title: Path

RangeFilter.description:
Numeric range on a facet (years asked, pay, posted age). ``not_stated`` says what a
missing value does: ``exclude`` (default) fails the record, ``include`` passes it.
RangeFilter.title: RangeFilter

TextFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring search over the named fields (all words must appear).
TextFilter.title: TextFilter

UnknownDataPolicy.description: None means: use the global setting (scoring.unknown_*).
UnknownDataPolicy.title: UnknownDataPolicy

ValueFilter.description: A facet chip set: include values, exclude values, ``any``/``all`` within the facet.
ValueFilter.title: ValueFilter
